whatItIs: Deploys a per-asset fraction of VRT's reserves into the protocol's OWN ValinityDAX VY/asset pools as one-sided, protocol-owned asset DEPTH (instead of the old Uniswap-V3 concentrated-LP yield). A CLOSED LEG of VRT: it shuffles cap-units between VCO and its own capVRYO ledger (globalCap = vco.getAssetCap + capVRYO is CONSERVED); it does NOT mint or move circulating VY. Per managed asset A in {WETH,WBTC,PAXG}: target = globalCap(A) x assetDeployRatioBps[A]/10000. DEPLOY (execute->_rebalanceAsset->deployStep self-call under try/catch): move dCap VCO->VRYO (vco.decreaseAssetCap), pull dCap x vco.getLTV(A) asset from VRT (vrt.deployForYield, VRYO_ROLE), inject into the DAX pool (dax.reserveInjectAsset, RESERVE_OFFICER_ROLE); books deployedAsset += the DAX's ACTUAL balance gain (FoT-safe), capVRYO += dCap; LTV-neutral; officer holds NO asset between txs. RECALL (_recall): move dCap VRYO->VCO (vco.increaseAssetCap), extract dCap x (deployedAsset/capVRYO) [STALE blended LTV] asset from the DAX straight to VRT (reserveExtractAsset recipient=VRT); clamped to the pool's live asset reserve + DAX real balance; try/caught. rescueTokens (ADMIN, works while paused): full-recall all to VRT + restore VCO caps.

fundFlow.asset: VRT -> officer(transient) -> DAX (deploy inject); DAX -> VRT (recall extract, recipient hardcoded address(vrt)). Officer holds NO asset between txs (balanceOf==balBefore invariant at deployStep).
fundFlow.cap: cap-units shuffle VCO <-> VRYO ledger only (vco.decreaseAssetCap/increaseAssetCap + capVRYO +=/-=). globalCap conserved. No circulating VY minted/moved.
fundFlow.noArbitraryDest: Every destination is hardcoded {DAX, VRT} or the VCO/capVRYO ledger; rescueTokens settles only to VRT; no caller-supplied recipient. CLOSED relative to roles.
